comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: Watching this on a Tuesday night from Hung Yen, Vietnam! 🇻🇳 The editorial decision to pair the stunning aerial shot of the canals in image_fda9bd.jpg with the harsh reality that these homes "Have Now Become A Luxury Dream For Most Residents" [13:18] is a brilliant piece of documentary filmmaking. It shatters the romanticized tourist illusion and highlights the deep inequality in the housing market. You don't just show the postcard; you show the real socio-economic struggle behind it. Great pacing and scriptwriting! 🇳🇱🎥
